Court No. - 70
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 53628 of 2023

Applicant :- Smt. Reshma Devi
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

Counsel for Applicant :- Om Narayan Pandey
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.
Heard Sri Mahendra Pandey, Advocate holding brief of Sri Om Narayan Pandey, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Imran Khan, learned AGA for the State.

2. The instant bail application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 618 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 304B IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Powayan,
District Shahjahapur during pendency of the trial.

3. FIR of the present case was lodged against applicant and her family members and according to the FIR marriage of the son of the applicant was performed with the daughter of the informant on 02.02.2023 and after marriage applicant and her family members tortured her for Rs. 2 lakhs and due to non fulfillment of demand of dowry on 25.08.2023 they have committed the murder of his daughter by strangulating her and hanged her body through Fan.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is mother-in-law of the deceased and on the basis of false allegation of demand of dowry and torture, she has been made accused in the Smt. sentences.text: He further submits that actually marriage of the deceased with the applicant was her love marriage but after marriage they used to fight with each other and it appears that some dispute arose between husband and wife and thereafter she hanged herself.
He further submits that this fact is evident from the statements of independent witnesses, which were recorded by the Investigating Officer during investigation.

6. He further submits that applicant resided separately in another village along with her husband i.e.
father-in-law of the deceased and this fact is evident from the residential certificate issued by the Gram Pradhan, which has been annexed as Annexure-6 to the affidavit.
7. He further submits that post mortem report of the deceased suggests that she died due to hanging and her hyoid bone was found intact.
He further submits that applicant is a lady and she is not having any criminal history and in the present matter she is in jail since 10.10.2023.

8. Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail and submits that daughter-in-law of the applicant died within six months of her marriage under abnormal circumstances and there is also allegation of demand of dowry.

He further submits that post mortem report of the deceased suggests that apart from ligature mark deceased also sustained one contusion but he could not dispute the fact that even as per statement of eye witnesses marriage of the deceased with the applicant was her love marriage and after marriage they used to fight with each other and due to the dispute with her husband she hanged herself.
9. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

10. However, daughter-in-law of the applicant died within six months of her marriage under abnormal circumstances in her matrimonial home and there is also allegation of demand of dowry but post mortem report suggests that deceased died due to hanging and her hyoid bone was found intact.

11. However, in the post mortem report apart from the ligature mark one contusion was also noted but possibility at this stage cannot be ruled out that victim at the time of commission of alleged suicide might have sustained this contusion.

12. Further, even, independent witnesses during investigation stated that marriage of the deceased with the applicant was her love marriage and after marriage both very often fight with each other and due to dispute arose between husband and wife, wife committed suicide by hanging herself.

13. Further, applicant is mother-in-law of the deceased and there is no specific allegation against her and there is certificate of Gram Pradhan, Meera Devi, which has been annexed as Annexure-6 to the affidavit, which shows that applicant resided in another village along with her husband.

sentences.text: Further, applicant is a lady and she is not having any criminal history and in the present matter she is in jail since 10.10.2023.

15. Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case discussed above, in my view,
applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
16. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

17. Let the applicant - Smt. Reshma Devi be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
18.
In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

19. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
